title: Understanding the Data Distribution
text: Observe the distribution of the points. The orange points form a ring around the blue points. This suggests a non-linear boundary between the classes.

title: Logistic Regression Capabilities
text: Logistic regression is a linear classifier. It can separate classes with a linear boundary. Consider whether a linear boundary can separate the classes in the image.

title: Analyzing the Boundary
text: Can a linear boundary separate the inner blue points from the outer orange points?

title: Conclusion for Logistic Regression
text: Since logistic regression can only create linear boundaries, it cannot generate the circular boundary needed to separate these classes.
